question: By which year does India aim to publish the National Red Data Books for both flora and fauna, as announced at the IUCN World Conservation Congress 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2030.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India aims to publish the National Red Data Books for both flora and fauna by 2030, as part of its biodiversity conservation efforts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The announcement was made during the IUCN World Conservation Congress 2025 by Union Minister Kirti Vardhan Singh.**
 
• **The National Red List Roadmap aims to develop a science-based framework for assessing and monitoring the conservation status of India's diverse species.**
 
• **The project was developed in collaboration with organizations such as the IUCN, Zoological Survey of India (ZSI), Botanical Survey of India (BSI), and the Centre for Species Survival.**
 
• **The Red Data Books will provide essential data to guide conservation efforts and are aligned with global biodiversity frameworks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• IUCN World Conservation Congress__

 __
 
• An important global event that addresses conservation issues and provides a platform for sharing ideas and policies on biodiversity protection.
 
 
 
• Red Data Books__
 __
 
• A compilation of the conservation status of species, providing critical information for conservation policy and actions to prevent extinction.
 
 
 
• National Red List Roadmap__
 
 
• A framework to assess and monitor India's species, aiming to make a significant contribution to global biodiversity conservation efforts.
